scope:
Opt-in instrumented reverse: CTA cycles, never an exact wall-clock split.

Numerical parity gates run before the full-shape diagnostic. Instrumentation
changes barriers/register pressure and can change timings; no speedup claim.
warning: CTA cycle sums are occupancy-weighted, not additive full-step wall phases. Extra barriers/clock instructions/registers perturb execution. Device-ms splits are explicitly estimates; use uninstrumented fused wall as authoritative.
